title: [#324] Drop the Metals MCP fileInFocus workaround for glob searches
body:
Metals 1.6.9 shipped scalameta/metals-feature-requests#464 (scalameta/metals#8776): `glob-search` and `typed-glob-search` now search the whole workspace without a `fileInFocus`. This drops the workaround from the agent instructions.

## Changes

- **`CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md`**: replace "Symbol tool file focus" (a `fileInFocus` for every symbol tool, three parallel queries per project-wide search) with a shorter "Symbol tool targets" section. The glob searches need no target. `get-usages`, `get-docs` and `get-source` take the owning module as `module`, derived from the "Packages" table in `module-overview.md` (`<module>-test` for test code).
- **`docs/agents/metals-mcp-inspect-workaround.md`** (new, loaded on demand): `inspect` still returns no members when given `module` (scalameta/metals#8880), so it keeps using a `fileInFocus`. Delete this doc and its pointer once that issue is fixed.
- **`scoverage-inspector` skill**: point to the new section.
- **`docs/development/metals-mcp-claude-code-setup.md`**: require Metals 1.6.9, and explain that a running dev stack needs `bin/microtonalist-dev-stack restart` after `cs update metals`.
- **`build.sbt`**: fix the `experiments` module's `name`, which was a copy of `microtonalist-app`.
